about: Independent adjudication of every candidate that cleared the pre-registered distance and in-context gates. Reviewers received the verbatim rule text, the +/-2-turn window, the tool calls, and the task the user stated — and were not told which verdict was wanted. Phase 0 step 3 of road-to-activation-evidence-or-refusal.

coverage.D-A_D-C: complete — all 37 candidates in all 9 sessions carrying a D-A or D-C qualifying row
coverage.D-B: sample — 30 candidates across all 10 sessions carrying a D-B qualifying row (3 highest-distance rows per session)
